svg.title: The latter uses the wedge-sum primitive and bilinearity, with the curl-reduction and invariant- form hypotheses retained. The paid direction tWa(ξ) gives t2|caa| ≤cf. Also admissible is u = t 2(Wa(ξ) + Wb(ξ)). At the critical identity repeated ordered left derivative equals the diagonal Hessian and 4D2f(1)[u, u] = t2(caa + cbb + 2cab).
